setting.name: User Interface Language
setting.comment: Preferred language to be used in client user interfaces.

setting.name: Max Rows Per Page
setting.comment: The default maximum number of rows displayed in any listing.

setting.name: Dynamic Severity
setting.comment: Whether to use dynamic severity scores by default.

setting.name: Auto-Refresh
setting.comment: The delay between automatic page refreshs in seconds.

setting.name: Details Export File Name
setting.comment: File name format string for the export of resource details.

setting.name: List Export File Name
setting.comment: File name format string for the export of resource lists.

setting.name: Report Export File Name
setting.comment: File name format string for the export of reports.

setting.name: Default Severity
setting.comment: Severity to use if none is specified or available from SecInfo.

setting.name: Auto Cache Rebuild
setting.comment: Whether to rebuild report caches on changes affecting severity.

setting.name: Note/Override Excerpt Size
setting.comment: The maximum length of notes and override text shown in reports without enabling note/override details.

setting.name: Debian LSC Package Maintainer
setting.comment: Maintainer email address used in generated Debian LSC packages.

setting.name: Feed Import Roles
setting.comment: Roles given access to new resources from feed.

setting.name: SecInfo SQL Buffer Threshold
setting.comment: Buffer size threshold in MiB for running buffered SQL statements in SecInfo updates before the end of the file being processed.

setting.name: User Interface Time Format
setting.comment: Preferred time format to be used in client user interfaces.

setting.name: User Interface Date Format
setting.comment: Preferred date format to be used in client user interfaces.

setting.name: Maintenance Window
setting.comment: Time window in which no scans are allowed.

setting.name: Agent Owner
setting.comment: User who is given ownership of new Agents.

setting.name: Integration Configs Owner
setting.comment: User who is given ownership of integration configs.

setting.name: Feed Import Owner
setting.comment: User who is given ownership of new resources from feed.

setting.name: Rows Per Page
setting.comment: The default number of rows displayed in any listing.
